correctness.rationale: Every relevant factor has zero or two ones; a two-one factor uniquely corresponds to a parity-restricted diagonal-strip lattice point. Uniform O(n) comparison to strip area and convergence of uniform weak compositions establish the weak limit and moment convergence. The closed positive-part area formula follows by triangle subtraction. The six-region exact rational integration gives E[A]=1/24, E[A²]=5/1728 and Var[A/2]=1/3456; two reproducible standalone checkers independently verify the finite factor formula and exact area integrals. Boundaries with zero gaps are included; no finite test is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: This answers the natural fixed-composition typical-case question left separate from the prior sharp five-run worst-case result. It gives a nondegenerate weak limit and exact rational variance for the same distinct-factor statistic, demonstrating quadratic-scale randomness instead of convergence to a deterministic mean. The six-piece gap-simplex geometry is a structural explanation, and the exact variance is not supplied by the known maxima or general quadratic-growth construction. The result does not claim a theorem for other weights or unrestricted Bernoulli models.
